thread:
ana (Product Design): quick gut check: compact members table — should required fields use an asterisk with sr-only text or the visible word 'Required'? also, validation when pasting many rows: inline errors, top summary, or both? ben (PM): ops says explicit 'Required' on legal fields only. otherwise asterisk is fine if screen readers see it. mike (Design): proposal: asterisk for compact rows + tooltip; visible 'Required' on expanded forms. for pastes: show top summary with count + inline errors for each row that has an issue. minimal layout shift. chun (Eng): implementation: reserve error slot to avoid jump; anchor links from top summary to the problematic row; typed confirm only for destructive actions >30 rows (org-configurable). for confirm input: disable CTA until exact match and debounce paste. rita (A11y): accessibility checks: 1) asterisk must have sr-only 'required' label. 2) error summary should be focusable and use role="alert". 3) don't rely on color alone. aria snippet:
3 rows need attention
then focusable link to row. nana (Product Design): small copy tweak: top summary -> "3 rows need attention. Click to jump to first issue." Confirm copy: "This will remove access for N members. To confirm, type REMOVE." ben (PM): decision: default = asterisk + sr-only for compact; visible 'Required' for compliance fields; paste flow = summary + inline; typed confirm = org toggle for >30 rows; telemetry to be added. follow-up in 48h. :thumbsup:
